Controller edits / agent access
|-- MappingDocumentController: private context, snapshot, listeners, nodeCache, pendingNodeIds
|-- The controller manages document and canvas state and publishes completed updates.
|-- ControllerSnapshot: contextId, canvasRevisionId, document, canvas, version, canUndo, canRedo
|-- Layout measurements and endpoint bounds are retained separately from content revisions.
|-- constructor(...) -> historyService.openContext(document, canvas, normalizedHistory)
|-- The runtime handle references service-managed history.
|-- nodes() -> canvasDisplayNodes(...); return structuredClone(cachedNodes)
|-- Snapshot identity controls the derived node cache.
|-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations) -> applyOperations(...); transact(...) -> applyUpdate(...)
|-- Version checks guard batches of one to one hundred operations.
|-- applyOperations: structuredClone(snapshot) -> staged operations -> updateSnapshot(..., true)
|-- Staged edits can see earlier batch changes before the live head advances.
|-- prepareDiagramEdit(document, diagramId, edit) -> diagrams.revise(currentRevisionId, edit)
|-- Content replacement, patches, mappings and jumps use the diagram service.
|-- diagram-create -> diagrams.create(...); diagram-insert -> diagrams.getRevision(...)
|-- Insertion creates a summary through insertGridDiagram and lays out the scene.
|-- patchDiagram -> trackNodes(nodeIds), lineAfter(line), layoutScene(...)
|-- Correspondence rebases matching edge anchors, jumps, folds and sections.
|-- diagram-revision-apply -> receiveDiagramRevision(expectedRevisionId, revision)
|-- Applying a generated revision first checks that the expected revision is still current.
|-- grid move/collapse/group -> updateGridBox(...) -> layoutScene(...) [schematic]
|-- Floating moves use pixel coordinates and switch placement to manual.
|-- floating collapse/remove -> setExpansion(...) | removeDisplayNode(...) [schematic]
|-- Edge edits validate anchors; arrows follow anchors and cannot be moved as free panes.
|-- updateSnapshot -> reconcileConnections(...), normalizeDiagramViews(...), resolveFloatingGeometry(...)
|-- Removed instances leave membership; captured regions can remain as stale snapshots.
|-- record === true -> historyService.append(context, document, canvas, pendingNodeIds)
|-- Recording advances history; default updateCanvas calls keep transient updates unrecorded.
|-- select(command) -> updateCanvas(updateSelection(...), true)
|-- Selection commands deliberately use the recorded path.
|-- useAgentCanvasBridge -> register, poll commands, handle(command), reply [schematic]
|-- The bridge manages its abort controller, retry timer and bounded mutation receipt cache.
|-- handleAgentCommand('apply') -> controller.applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
|-- Page receipts deduplicate requests; busy and hidden document checks guard access.
|-- handleAgentCommand('context') -> { version, name, nodes, edges }
|-- Context reads omit history; snapshot requests include exported history.
|-- bridge cleanup -> abort.abort(), clearTimeout(timer), unregister()
`-- Live selection publishing receives the workspace and reports agent connection status.
